verdict.rationale: PostHog exposes a live OpenAPI 3.0 spec (openapi.json probe confirms it) and endpoint-level OpenAPI specs for generating typed clients, which supports an API reference, but there is no evidence of an interactive documentation UI (like Swagger UI/Redoc) with runnable/try-it-now examples embedded in the docs site itself — the closest 'runnable' experience shown is MCP tool calling (call/exec commands) rather than a browsable interactive API reference. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API reference UI (e.g., Swagger/Redoc try-it-out console) on posthog.com/docs, and independent/hands-on confirmation that examples in the API docs are actually runnable in-browser.
